note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors (the Downpatrick rural district), polled Thursday 2 June 1955. Two contests, Ballynahinch and Downpatrick (Irish News, 2 June 1955, p. 5; results Irish News, 3 June 1955, p. 1). No change.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Downpatrick' to Downpatrick Rural (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-66 name the DED Downpatrick Rural; the rounds were filed as Downpatrick Rural (1927, 1930, 1939, 1952); Downpatrick (1955, 1967). This round was filed as 'Downpatrick', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (downpatrick) answers with a redirect to this one.
